task: Review bounded semantic compatibility of upstream 32.54 integration and fork-only update routing. Evidence establishes code behavior only, never device acceptance.

checks.claim: The new not-interested action retains the existing feedback-token path when no engagement-panel endpoint is available.
A stored preferred host can reorder the supplied download URLs but cannot add an upstream download URL that is absent from the feed.
The generated manifest routes supported ABI downloads through the existing updater parser and supplies the integer versionCode used for update comparison.
Reinstalling the same active subtitle timeline does not reset the translation dispatcher, preserving the fix for duplicate translation requests.
